_source: Icehunter/dune-admin (MIT) cmd/dune-admin/progression_presets.go — preset catalog (ids, names, descriptions, node roots). Our port applies them via the GAME's own procs dune.complete_journey_story_nodes_for_player / reset_journey_story_nodes_for_player (gathering root + descendants per account), instead of dune-admin's direct-UPDATE reimplementation.
_note: Each preset's `nodes` are ROOT journey story-node ids. unlock/lock gathers each root + every descendant (story_node_id LIKE 'root.%') that exists for the account, then calls the proc with the full id array. node_count is the approximate total (root + children) for reference; actual touched count depends on how far the character has progressed.

presets.name: Skip NPE (New Player Experience)
presets.description: Marks the tutorial/NPE as complete. Useful for experienced players who don't need the intro.

presets.name: Complete: A New Beginning
presets.description: Main story intro — crafting Stillsuit, harvesting resources, fabricator research. Unlocks early game.

presets.name: Complete: Find the Fremen (Trials of Aql)
presets.description: All 7 trials, the Sietch, and Epilogue. Unlocks the Fremkit (Stillsuit, Thumper, Cryss Knife, etc.) and completes Act 1.

presets.name: Complete: All of Act 1
presets.description: A New Beginning + Find the Fremen combined. Player starts ready for Act 2.

presets.name: Skip: Vermillius Gap Tutorials
presets.description: Completes all Vermillius Gap tutorial quests (research, crafting, exploration). No tag side effects — pure tutorial skip.

presets.name: Skip: Deep Desert Intro
presets.description: Completes the Deep Desert side quest chain.

presets.name: Skip: Overland Map Intro
presets.description: Completes the Overland map side quest chain (Hark Landsraad missions, keystones).

presets.name: Unlock All Lore (Dunipedia)
presets.description: Reveals all Dunipedia entries: Known Universe, Landmarks, Manual of the Friendly Desert, War for Arrakis.
